A '''mission''' was undertook on [[Orvax IV]] in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]] by [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Dass Jennir]] and the crew of the ''[[Uhumele]]'' in order to rescue the [[Mesa Greenbark|wife]] and the [[Resa Greenbark|daughter]] of [[Bomo Greenbark]].
